$comment: Frictionless Table Schema of a merged file's event index, merged_<...>.events.csv (decision record 0007). The fields are the contract: readers check the CSV's header against them.
name: event-index
title: Events in a merged file

fields.name: eventStart
fields.description: When the file's footage really started: ISO 8601 with its UTC offset, in the camera's time zone, after the clock offset or the series' shift.

fields.name: offsetSeconds
fields.description: Where its slot starts in the merged file, in seconds from the merged file's first frame; about +-20 ms. A later file whose video starts late (by at most a fraction of a second) shows its first frame that much after its offset. Empty if not known.

fields.name: durationSeconds
fields.description: How long it plays in the merged file, in seconds. Empty if not known.

fields.name: filePath
fields.description: The converted file, relative to the output folder, with forward slashes.

fields.name: shiftSeconds
fields.description: Seconds added to the camera's time: the clock offset (decision record 0005), or the series' shift (decision record 0006).
